publication.head: codex/5701-runtime-v3-openapi-contracts
publication.title: [v0.91.8][runtime-v3][api] Define Runtime v3 OpenAPI contracts (#5701)
publication.body:
Closes #5701
Closes #5718

## Summary

Defines and serves the complete versioned Runtime v3 Core and Observatory OpenAPI contracts from the guardian-launched Axum/Tokio/Rustls listener. Health, metrics, and Observatory reads are public; writes require operator login and retain authoritative runtime signature and policy verification. The separate HTML Observatory keeps its existing design while moving to the version-neutral `demos/html-observatory/` public path with Runtime v3 branding.

## Validation

- HTML Observatory integrated proof passed.
- Validation-lane selector contract passed.
- Runtime v3 explicit Observatory opt-in parity test passed.
- Runtime API health/telemetry/init contract test passed.
- Browser verified `https://localhost:8765/demos/html-observatory/?runtime=v3&runtimeApiBase=https://localhost:20997&live=1` with Runtime v3 branding and the existing design.
- Exact GPT-5.5 review passed with zero findings at product commit 7801b941d0f00a89c8e8ebe4bc70eb93a73a8359.
- `git diff --check` passed.
